verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM presents itself as a private AI assistant and agent, so it occupies the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents is a different product role. The only MCP evidence is a page titled 'MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM', which reads as client-side support for plugging in MCP servers. The automated probe labels that same page an 'official MCP server', but nothing explicitly shows AnythingLLM itself running as an MCP server (such as a serve mode or hosted endpoint), so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
